principle: Estimated values are allowed when the anchor, formula, uncertainty band, system boundary and non-observed status are explicit.

anchor.note: External 2026 study; not operator-reported metered consumption.

backup_power_crosscheck.boundary: existing + planned data centers in 2024 YVA full-build scope; 100% backup for critical equipment
backup_power_crosscheck.interpretation: Useful only as an order-of-magnitude consistency check. Fuel power is not electrical output, the YVA scope includes planned expansion, and backup covers critical equipment rather than defining annual average load.
backup_power_crosscheck.forbidden_use: Do not multiply backup MW by 8760 h to estimate annual electricity consumption.

hamina.cooling_note: Google separately describes seawater cooling at Hamina. Reported withdrawal/consumption must not be treated as total seawater cooling throughput.

seawater_cooling.note: YVA states actual withdrawals have remained below the permitted ceiling.

reported_non_seawater.definition: Google-reported operational water metrics excluding seawater; consumption = withdrawal - discharge.

non_seawater_consumption_intensity_proxy.formula: 2024 non-seawater consumption / IT energy derived from electricity scenario and PUE 1.10
non_seawater_consumption_intensity_proxy.warning: Not standard measured WUE. Water=2024, PUE=2025, electricity anchor=2026 external estimate; excludes seawater.

kemi.note: Metsä Fibre calls 10 m3/t a raw-water design value but also explains that the design value refers to total wastewater generated at planned output; retain as a water-use design proxy, not measured withdrawal.

descriptive_ratio.interpretation: Rabbit-hole indicators only. Different water concepts and statuses must remain visible: Hamina 2024 reported withdrawal, Hamina seawater permit ceiling, and Kemi design proxy are not interchangeable.

cross_sector_score: same water concept: withdrawal or consumption
same status: measured actual or design scenario
normalization denominator representing comparable resource/value output
preferred_candidates: absolute freshwater withdrawal as descriptive burden
